cases.title: Okafor v. City of Port Alder - vehicle damage claim (pothole, 1388 Harbor Street)
cases.demand_breakdown_note: Counsel's demand adds $1,200 attorney fees to the $4,470 claim.

events.event: Resident reports pothole near 1388 Harbor Street eastbound (311 SR-2026-061744): approx 45 cm wide, 10 cm deep.
311 triage assigns priority P2 (72-hour SLA) although Harbor Street is a designated arterial (P1, 24-hour SLA under the 311 Service Standards).
Crew inspection; cold patch scheduled under work order WO-2026-22817; asphalt plant supply shortage noted.
Second resident report merged as duplicate (SR-2026-064102): 'pothole getting bigger'.
Incident at 21:40: claimant's 2019 sedan strikes the pothole; two tyres and one rim damaged. Claimant's dashcam shows 34 mph in a 30 mph zone, wet road, street lights on.
Repair invoice from Eastgate Tire & Auto: $3,870 (2 tyres, 1 rim, alignment).
Permanent hot-mix repair completed; SR-2026-061744 closed (17 days after first report).
Government claim form filed with the City Clerk for $4,470.
Risk Management acknowledges the claim; adjuster assigned.
City issues written notice of claim rejection.
Streets Superintendent notes: no completion entry for the 4 May cold patch; contractor not working on that block in May.
Demand letter from Brightwater Law Group: $5,670 including $1,200 attorney fees; threatens limited civil suit in Alder County Superior Court.
File assigned to Deputy City Attorney Nadia Brennan for liability review and settlement recommendation.

deadline_rules.name: Claim filing deadline (180 days after incident)
City decision on claim (45 days after filing, otherwise deemed rejected)
Claimant's deadline to sue (6 months after written rejection)

record_gaps: No completion entry for the cold patch scheduled on 2026-05-04 (WO-2026-22817)
Original dashcam video file not yet obtained (only stills)
No crew-availability or materials log for 2026-05-04 to 2026-05-19
No photo or measurement of the pothole depth on the incident date

cases.title: Granite Ridge Construction v. City of Port Alder - bid protest and petition for writ of mandate (ITB-2026-044)

events.event: ITB-2026-044 Harbor Street Repaving Phase 2 advertised; bids due 2026-09-11 14:00; 5% bid bond must be enclosed with the sealed bid.
Coastline Paving's project manager emails the Public Works Director asking to meet about Phase 2; Director redirects her to Procurement (cone of silence).
Bid opening: Granite Ridge $1,698,900 (no bid bond enclosed), Coastline $1,742,300, Ostrander Civil $1,779,500.
Granite Ridge emails a bid bond PDF at 14:12, after the 14:00 deadline.
Chief Procurement Officer finds Granite Ridge non-responsive (no bid security at opening).
Notice of intent to award to Coastline Paving Co. (local preference applied: $25,000 cap).
City Council awards the contract (Resolution 2026-188); contract executed the same day.
Granite Ridge files a written protest with the Chief Procurement Officer.
CPO rejects the protest as untimely and on the merits.
Granite Ridge files public records request PRR-2026-0409 for all bids and evaluation records.
Petition for writ of mandate filed in Alder County Superior Court seeking to set aside the award.
Petition served on the City Clerk; Coastline Paving mobilised on site on 2026-11-02.

deadline_rules.name: Bid protest deadline (5 business days after notice of intent to award)
City's response to the petition (30 days after service)

record_gaps: Procurement inbox server log for 2026-09-11 14:00-14:15 not yet preserved
No written CPO determination on the 2026-08-30 cone-of-silence contact
